text: dev-b: libs/shared-contracts is inlined at build time (no registry version). core-shell and reports only redeploy if a file under their apps/ dir changes, so I'll push a small touch in each AFTER your billingUrl PR is merged to main. Please msg me when it's merged. Heads-up: CD change detection/publish also may not cover reports in docs, but Jenkinsfile.cd does.

PLAT-104-1 merged to main (shared-contracts billingUrl=/billing/v2, lib v1.0.1). Lib is inlined at build time (no registry publish), and CD only deploys when apps/<app>/ changes, so your apps need a change under their dir (e.g. version bump) to rebuild+ship. Pull main first.
